data.name: Fabaz
data.gender_notes: Fabaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-b-z' meaning 'to exalt, to be noble'. In Islamic tradition, Fabaz symbolizes the highest virtues and qualities. The name Fabaz carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fabaz usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Fabaz holds spiritual significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing the strength and protection of Allah's creatures. It is a reminder of the power and grace of nature, and the importance of cherishing and respecting all living beings.
data.etymology: Fabaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fabaz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Fabaz originates from the Arabic root F-B-Z, which signifies opening, expansion, or unfolding. This name is used in various Islamic cultures to denote a person who brings about goodness, prosperity, and opportunities. Etymologically linked to concepts of relief and facilitation in Quranic contexts, Fabaz embodies the attributes of being a bringer of hope and positive change. Historically, names derived from this root have been associated with benevolence and the removal of difficulties.
